operations.description: Retrieve the TOC (articles) for a CVDR document version. Flat list parsed from the toestand XML at indexer time. Each entry carries id, nr, title, kind, startPage and startSourceFile.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Manifest expression label. Defaults to the currently valid version.

CvdrTocResponse.description: Table of contents for a CVDR document version. Flat list of articles parsed from the toestand XML at indexer time.

toc.description: Flat list of article entries. Each entry carries id, nr, title, kind, startPage and startSourceFile.

JsonNode.description: Article entry parsed from the toestand XML at indexer time, carrying id, nr, title, kind, startPage and startSourceFile.
